title: Serene Near the Sea | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Serene Near the Sea is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Welcome to your dream coastal retreat, Serene Near the Sea! This 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom haven offers spacious luxury just a short stroll from the stunning beach. With 3 king rooms, a Loft featuring twin bunk beds, a 3rd floor bunkroom, and two sleeper sofas, this 3-story gem comfortably sleeps 16 and is conveniently situated on the West End of 30A, located in the Serenity at Dune Allen neighborhood. This home is across the street from the Dune Allen Beach Access. Embrace the coastal lifestyle with the gorgeous waters of the Emerald Coast just down the block.The first floor's open concept is an entertainer's delight, featuring a dining room table for 10, an island with an additional 5 seats, a large sectional sofa that pulls into a queen bed and a downstairs master for added convenience. Upstairs, discover two additional king bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, and a Loft bunk bed . The 3rd floor boasts a sprawling living area with a sofa that pulls into a full bed, bunk room, balcony, and full bathroom – a perfect spot for the kids.Outdoors, the private patio beckons with a propane grill, outdoor sofa, television, a picnic table that seats 8, chairs, and a fire pit – an ideal spot to unwind after a day in the sun. This home also grants you access to a community pool for a refreshing dip right around the corner.For those dreaming of expansive celebrations or gatherings, consider booking the neighboring house, Serene Stay on 30A. Together, these two homes create a haven for grand events, accommodating larger groups, weddings, and multi-generational families. With a total of 2 golf carts, sleeping arrangements for 28, and boasting 8 bedrooms between them, this combination ensures a serene and memorable stay on the beautiful 30A coast. Whether you're planning a wedding, a family reunion, or a big getaway with friends, this dynamic duo of coastal retreats provides the perfect setting for unforgettable moments and cherished memories.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed. Private bathroom. Living room sleeper sofa- queen.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed. Private bathroom.2nd Floor Loft: Twin-over-twin bunk bed.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed. Private bathroom.3rd Floor, Bedroom 4 Bunkroom: 1 twin-over twin bunk bed and 1 full-over-full bunk bed. Living room sleeper sofa- full.Beach Access:Head down Serene Way to Charming Way and keep walking until you reach your beach access, Dune Allen Regional Beach Access.Distance: .3 miles | Time: 7 minutes walkingSerenity at Dune Allen:Located on the quieter, western end of 30A, Serenity at Dune Allen embodies coastal tranquility. This charming neighborhood seamlessly links you to the area's diverse culinary delights, unique boutique shopping, scenic cycling paths, and extensive golf courses. Conveniently connected to Highway 98, you can effortlessly explore nearby gems like Destin and Panama City Beach, all while enjoying proximity to the Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport. This is the perfect place to discover the serene side of the Emerald Coast.Your stay at Serene Near the Sea comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Golf Cart Included* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars.An initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
